description: This file defines a React hook and utility functions for progressively applying work in batches, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback. It manages UI state related to progress and supports canceling ongoing operations.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages progressive batch processing of items, with start and cancel capabilities, progress reporting, and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller, managing UI state such as running status, progress percentage, and counts, and providing methods to start processing from items and cancel.
